paragraphs: Emburse sells travel and expense management software to finance teams. The platform covers expense, travel, accounts payable, cards, invoices and ACH payments, with localization for more than 100 countries.

Receipts are read by optical character recognition, whether the paper original or a digital copy. Spend is sorted automatically across dozens of categories, with VAT reconciliation and multiple currencies handled along the way. Policies are written once and enforced across the organization rather than checked afterward. A compliance layer examines receipts before and after submission, applying policy consistently and flagging risk early. For travel, the company sits alongside a customer's existing travel management company rather than replacing it, rebooking air and hotel when prices fall under rules the customer sets. It also connects to ERP, finance and accounting systems.

The company states that it serves over 20,000 organizations in 200 countries and territories. Those customers are described as large enterprises, smaller businesses, public sector agencies and nonprofits. Marne Martin is the chief executive. In July 2026 the company announced that it had been named to CNBC's list of the world's top fintech companies for that year.
